newsitem.title: USA: Amazon.com cuts prices on 400,000 titles.
newsitem.headline: Amazon.com cuts prices on 400,000 titles.

text.p: Amazon.com Inc. said Tuesday it cut prices on more than 400,000 book titles it sells via its World Wide Web page.
Every hardcover is at least 30 percent off and every paperback is at least 20 percent off. Specially featured books are discounted 40 percent.
Amazon.com, based in Seattle, has a catalogue of 2.5 million titles that it offers online.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Amazon.com's stock edged down 37.5 cents to $19.875 on Nasdaq at mid-morning.
